key.name: granularity
key.description: How many percentage points to increase or decrease the brightness on each scroll tick.

key.name: invert-scroll
key.description: Scrolling up decreases the brightness, scrolling down increases it.

key.name: min-brightness
key.description: Lowest brightness level in percent that scrolling can reach. Very low values can make the screen hard to see and navigate.

key.name: dim-level
key.description: Software brightness level (1.0 = no dimming). Persisted so it survives re-login and lock.

key.name: modifier-key
key.description: Only change the brightness on scroll while this modifier key is held down. "none" means scrolling always changes the brightness.
